title: Smaller Than Expected
text: Smaller Than Expected. I love three tined forks and especially the smaller salad forks we've had in the family for decades. I got these, black being my favorite color, and while I'm going to use them they did turn out to be quite smaller than I expected and are kind of silly but still well made and durable.
